title: eo list --json — a product's internal nodes
description: Emitted by `eo list <ref> [path] --json` (src/eosdk/cli/commands/listing.py) as a JSON ARRAY of nodes, one per entry of the product's internal tree at the requested path (SPEC §6.6). Each element is Node.model_dump(mode="json") (src/eosdk/models.py::Node). The same array shape is produced by every backend (`--via http` and `--via s3`) and by `--recursive`; only the number of entries differs. Hand-written on purpose: it is a contract, not a projection of the model. `additionalProperties` is true on the node object — downstream consumers must tolerate fields added later.

node.description: One file or directory inside a product.

name.description: Entry name, without any parent path.

path.description: Logical, backend-agnostic path relative to the product root; each backend translates it to its own addressing. Never absolute and never prefixed with the product name.

is_dir.description: True for directories. Directories carry no size and are never downloadable targets.

size.description: Size in bytes for files; null for directories and where the backend does not report one.

checksum.description: Per-node checksum where the backend advertises one; null otherwise.

raw.description: The untouched backend document the node was normalized from (an OData Nodes entry, an S3 object listing). Backend-specific by design.
